fields.label: Background
fields.content: By terms of the 1960 Treaty of Establishment that created the independent Republic of Cyprus, the UK retained full sovereignty and jurisdiction over two areas of almost 254 square kilometers in total: Akrotiri and Dhekelia. The larger of these is the Dhekelia Sovereign Base Area, which is also referred to as the Eastern Sovereign Base Area.

fields.label: Location
fields.content: on the southeast coast of Cyprus near Famagusta

fields.label: Map references
fields.content: Middle East

fields.label: Area
fields.content:
total: 130.8 sq km

note: area surrounds three Cypriot enclaves

fields.label: Area - comparative
fields.content: about three-quarters the size of Washington, DC

fields.label: Land boundaries
fields.content: total: NA; note - boundary with Cyprus is being resurveyed

fields.label: Climate
fields.content: temperate; Mediterranean with hot, dry summers and cool winters

fields.label: Environment - current issues
fields.content: netting and trapping of small migrant songbirds in the spring and autumn

fields.label: Geography - note
fields.content: British extraterritorial rights also extended to several small off-post sites scattered across Cyprus

fields.label: Population
fields.content:
no indigenous personnel

note: approximately 2,200 military personnel are on the base; there are another 5,000 British citizens who are families of military personnel or civilian staff on both the bases of Akrotiri and Dhekelia; Cyprus citizens work on the base, but do not live there

fields.label: Languages
fields.content: English, Greek

fields.label: Country name
fields.content:
conventional long form: Dhekelia Sovereign Base Area

conventional short form: Dhekelia

fields.label: Dependency status
fields.content: overseas territory of UK; administered by an administrator who is also the Commander, British Forces Cyprus

fields.label: Capital
fields.content: Episkopi Cantonment; located in Akrotiri

fields.label: Legal system
fields.content: the laws of the UK, where applicable, apply

fields.label: Executive branch
fields.content:
chief of state: Queen Elizabeth II (since 6 February 1952)

head of government: Administrator Maj. Gen. Peter Tomas Clayton PEARSON (since 9 May 2003); note - reports to the British Ministry of Defence

elections: none; the monarch is hereditary; the administrator is appointed by the monarch

fields.label: Diplomatic representation in the US
fields.content: none (overseas territory of the UK)

fields.label: Diplomatic representation from the US
fields.content: none (overseas territory of the UK)

fields.label: Flag description
fields.content: the flag of the UK is used

fields.label: Economy - overview
fields.content: Economic activity is limited to providing services to the military and their families located in Dhekelia. All food and manufactured goods must be imported.

fields.label: Industries
fields.content: none

fields.label: Military - note
fields.content:
includes Dheklia Garrison and Ayios Nikolaos Station connected by a roadway
